objective_metric.name: mean_poisson_deviance
objective_metric.definition: 2*sum(w*(y*log(y/p)-y+p))/sum(w), w the optional weight input (1 without it); finite y>=0; p below min_prediction counts as it
objective_metric.reason: A claim rate is scored by the Poisson deviance weighted by the years insured (synthetic data).

grouping.definition: A customer and their policies; new customers are scored, so a customer is held out whole.

scoring_columns.description: years insured: the rate's denominator, known only once the policy period has ended
